avis.titre: Natural, Gentle & So Effective! Great price too!
avis.texte: Wow! I finally found a makeup remover that doesn't irritate my eyes. After reading the label, I understood why—it isn't just the naturally derived ingredients and botanicals from organic farming, but it's also ophthalmologically tested. That gave me even more confidence using it around my eyes. Even my mascara comes off effortlessly. I simply hold a cotton pad with the geranium micellar water over my closed eye for a few seconds, then gently wipe—no rubbing, no stinging, and no watery eyes. I used to use another eye makeup remover that cost almost twice as much, but this gives me the same great results. Since discovering this one I haven't looked back.
